messages.author: 7969070d975feda4
messages.subject: fgui in shiny?
parts:
I wonder if anyone has thought about implementing something like the fgui package using Shiny?

(For those not familiar with it, fgui "automatically" generates a GUI for a function. The GUI uses tcltk widgets. I wonder how difficult it would be to use Shiny instead. Before attempting this myself I'd be interested to know if anyone else has tried this or has any thoughts on what might be involved.)

Thanks,
Steve

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: fgui in shiny?
parts: It would be possible. I haven't seen fgui but imagine the trickiest part would be figuring out the appropriate inputs/output of the function. Once you do that, you could have a static app directory in your package's "inst" directory, that contains generic ui.R and server.R files. These files could call back into your package code to actually (dynamically) generate the UI and server calls. To run the app you could use shiny::runApp in conjunction with system.file (the latter to find the folder containing ui.R and server.R).
